approvalNote: Reviewed side by side against ref.png at full size, plus the composition and overflow gates. Structure, hierarchy, reading order and every departure from the source confirmed against the template's own header notes. This is a MACHINE approval: no human has read these against the bank. Treat it as a gate that has been honestly passed, not as sign-off by the deck owner.

regions.note: Each carries --x and --y as percentages of the plot. Moving one is two numbers.

invariants: TWO categories maximum. A third needs a hue the closed palette does not carry for categorical data, and inventing one is how palettes rot.
Overlap between items is expected and correct. A cluster means those items scored alike; spacing them out to look tidy is editing the data.
Both axes are continuous and labelled low-to-high at their ends. If the scoring is really banded, use comp-priority-grid instead.
Below about ten items the scatter says less than a list; above thirty-five the labels collide past reading.
